ABOUT

ABOUT

Block Wizard — a procedural platformer. Levels and music are generated from the seed; every seed picks its own dance style (trance, techno, house, breaks, D&B, garage, electro…), tempo, key, rhythm and instruments.

Music instruments: sounds from the LiteGM SoundFont (v1.03) by Caed.

Changes made: a subset of the presets was selected, trimmed, resampled, compressed to 8-bit µ-law and gzipped to embed in this page. The adapted sounds remain under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sequencing and synthesis use the Web Audio API.
